title: Ageing and preventive care
learning_outcomes: Explain ageing and function in the context of ageing and preventive care.
Compare and distinguish prevention in the context of ageing and preventive care.
Apply screening trade-offs in the context of ageing and preventive care.
Evaluate and justify decisions about continuity of care in the context of ageing and preventive care.

lessons.title: Ageing and function
lessons.outcome: Explain ageing and function in the context of ageing and preventive care.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving ageing and function; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to preventive care question list.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain ageing and function from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of ageing and function; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Prevention
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish prevention in the context of ageing and preventive care.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving prevention; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to preventive care question list.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain prevention from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of prevention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Screening trade-offs
lessons.outcome: Apply screening trade-offs in the context of ageing and preventive care.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving screening trade-offs; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to preventive care question list.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain screening trade-offs from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of screening trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Continuity of care
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about continuity of care in the context of ageing and preventive care.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving continuity of care; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to preventive care question list.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain continuity of care from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of continuity of care; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of ageing and function; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of prevention; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of screening trade-offs; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of continuity of care; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
